ConflictRisk: One person could create unauthorized accounts
RecommendedControl: Require approval before account creation and review after onboarding
Require group-owner approval and record the request

ConflictRisk: One administrator could grant permanent privileged access
RecommendedControl: Require written approval and periodic privileged-role review

ConflictRisk: Attacker could impersonate a user and reset MFA
RecommendedControl: Require independent identity verification and ticket evidence

ConflictRisk: Unauthorized reset could enable account takeover
RecommendedControl: Verify identity and document the reset

ConflictRisk: Inactive accounts could retain unnecessary access
RecommendedControl: Review roles groups licences and retention date

ConflictRisk: Administrator could fail to remove all access
RecommendedControl: Use an offboarding checklist and validate sign-in is blocked

ConflictRisk: Unauthorized owner could approve future access
RecommendedControl: Require approval and document the ownership change

ConflictRisk: Changing both recovery accounts could cause tenant lockout
RecommendedControl: Modify only one account at a time and validate the other
Use pilot scope report-only mode emergency exclusions and rollback plan

ConflictRisk: Reviewer may approve their own access
RecommendedControl: Use separate reviewers where staffing allows
